body:
Nothing is expected to join this list- this won't be a requirement of removing anything by any means.

But, everything that could be web-visible and therefore customer impacting would be welcome. I used the word behavior to cast as wide a net as possible for what can be included, meaning the same "behavior" as in [Hyrum's Law](https://www.hyrumslaw.com/): "... all observable behaviors of your system
will be depended on by somebody.".
